description.value: Opened in 2022 in Vancouver's Little Italy neighbourhood on Commercial Drive, Mum's the Word is an equal-parts café, cocktail bar, and community hub serving Habitat coffee, classic and signature cocktails, BC craft beer and wine, and comfort-food sandwiches on sourdough from Fife Bakery. The eclectic, laidback spot prides itself on sourcing local purveyors and ingredients and has quickly become a neighbourhood gathering place. A touring cyclist stopping on Commercial Drive will find hot coffee, cold beer, a solid sandwich, and a welcoming vibe.

bike_parking_detail: 2 racks within 100m: stands (2 spaces) at 21m; stands (3 spaces) at 40m. Total: 5 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms the business is real and operating at 1301 Commercial Drive, Vancouver, matching OSM address and phone. The menu explicitly labels multiple vegan items with '(V)' and includes the note 'Ask about our vegan options!', confirming vegetarian/vegan offerings. No website or OSM evidence exists for bike parking, washrooms, water refill, Wi-Fi, or other cyclist-specific amenities.
concerns: Minor name capitalization discrepancy: OSM uses 'Mum's the Word' while the website consistently styles it as 'Mum's The Word' (capital T in 'The').
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, operating café and cocktail bar with an active website, confirmed address and phone, and a full food and drinks menu. A useful stop for touring cyclists on the Commercial Drive corridor.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Multiple vegan items on the food menu marked '(V)': Hippie Mum (chickpea 'tuna' salad with Chao vegan cheese), Feelin' Good (Field Roast vegan sausage, JUST Egg, Chao vegan cheese). Website also states 'Ask about our vegan options!' A zero-proof cocktail section is also present on the drinks menu

wow_evidence: quickly become a neighbourhood gathering place
